newsitem.title: USA: Buba's Schieber - Germany to hit 2.9-pct budget goal.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Schieber - Germany to hit 2.9-pct budget goal.

text.p: Bundesbank directorate member Helmut Schieber said on Tuesday he expects Germany will meet its budget deficit goal of 2.9 percent this year.
"I am convinced that Germany will reach the 2.9 percent goal," Schieber told reporters
Schieber said he expected Germany would resort to additional measures to meet the budget deficit goal if necessary. However, he declined to say what these might be.

European Union nations interested in joining Europe's planned currency union must meet strict entry criteria, including having a budget deficit of no more than three percent of gross domestic product.
